preventive.v: 100% coverage, NO waiting period. Routine Exam (2 per 12 months); Cleaning (2 per 12 months); Bitewing X-rays (1 per 12 months); Fluoride for children under age 16 (1 per 12 months).

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Classifying any product from its name. Doing so produces errors in both directions - calling insurance a membership, and calling a service a discount.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Never type or describe a product from its name. Read the Info page.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Nothing client-facing. This is an internal rule.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Product names in this portfolio are unreliable indicators of product type IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. 'AWA SimpleShield Membership Plan' is fixed indemnity insurance. 'Prime Health Pass Discount' is described on its own page as a Diagnostic Services Product delivering services. Between April and September NEO inserted the word 'Membership' into four Safe Guard product names without any evident change of type. Meanwhile 'AssistPro Discount' genuinely is a discount program.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Before any add-on is described on a call, and before any tooling assigns it a category.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Reading the product name and telling a client the plan includes vision coverage or an eye exam benefit. It includes a place to buy glasses cheaply.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not say 'includes vision coverage', 'covers your eye exam', or quote any exam benefit. Do not present the $42/pair figure as a benefit the plan pays.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: The dental side is insured coverage with percentages and an annual maximum. The vision side is a marketplace for buying glasses at lower prices - it is not vision insurance and I do not have a stated eye exam benefit for you.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The vision half of 'GHDP Dental & Vision' is XP Health 'Smarter Vision Care', an eyewear MARKETPLACE offering frames at an average $42/pair. The page markets it explicitly against vision insurance. No eye-exam benefit amount, copay or frequency is stated anywhere on the page.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: GHDP_DENTAL+VISION.pdf may state an exam benefit. Until it is read, the exam benefit is NOT_FOUND_IN_SOURCE.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Quoting the $1,500 / $3,000 / $5,000 annual maximum to a client who has a tooth problem now. Nothing in the Major Care list is available for twelve months.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not lead with the annual maximum. Do not say 'covered' about anything in the Major Care list without the twelve-month condition in the same sentence.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Cleanings, exams and x-rays start immediately at 100%. Fillings and simple extractions start immediately at 80%. Crowns, root canals, dentures, bridges and oral surgery are covered at 50% but only after you have been on the plan twelve months.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Major Care is covered at 50% with a 12 MONTH waiting period. Major Care includes crowns, dentures, bridges, endodontics (root canals), oral surgery, complex extractions, periodontics and anesthesia. Preventative (100%) and Basic (80%) have no waiting period.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: The asterisk on '100% Coverage*', '80% Coverage*' and '50% Coverage*' has a footnote that is not present on the page. Do not state the percentages as final without it.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Nothing directly - this is a defect in the document, not in what the agent says. But it means the clause telling the client who to contact about claims may be unreadable, and the client may later say they were never told who their agent was.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not tell a client the agreement names their agent.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Give the client your own name, agency and email verbally on the recorded call, and confirm you are their contact for benefit and claims questions. Do not rely on the agreement to have done it.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The FirstEnroll enrollment-agreement template served on the live storefront contains unrendered variables - $parentcompany, $product_label, $agent_fullname, $agent_Email, $parentemail - confirmed on two unrelated product families (American Financial Critical Illness page 38175, and Health Choice Silver page 32339). The affected clauses are the third-party administrator disclaimer, the Plan and Claims Inquiries clause and the Writing Agent Contact block.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Raise with FirstEnroll whether the executed enrollment document renders these variables. See G-039.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: For any product in this group, do not answer a coverage, exclusion, waiting-period or pre-existing question on a recorded call from portal material alone. Obtain the carrier document first.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: 51 of the 80 products on the NEO agent storefront have no brochure, certificate or policy document attached anywhere in the enrolment system. For those products the NEO reference page is the only available source, and four of those pages carry a limitations or exclusions heading with no text beneath it.

compliance_risks.verified_fact: GHDP Dental & Vision 1500 / 3000 / 5000 was swept and the annual maximum rises $1,500 to $3,000 to $5,000 with no benefit falling.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Until the PDFs are filed, any compliance challenge to a benefit statement on these products can be answered only with the ledger's citations, not with the underlying document. Treat filing them as outstanding remediation, not housekeeping.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Ten of the eleven linked brochures are READ and fully extracted into the ledger, but the PDF files themselves are not in Drive. The documents behind 25 live variants therefore exist in this project only as extracted facts, not as retrievable source documents.

benefit.basic_care.v: 80% coverage, NO waiting period. Full Mouth/Panoramic X-rays (1 per 3 years); Restorative Amalgams (fillings); Sealants (ages 6 through 16); Simple Extractions; Space Maintainers (child under 16).

benefit.major_care.v: 50% coverage, 12 MONTHS WAITING PERIOD. Onlays; Oral Surgery; Crowns (1 per tooth per 7 years); Crown Repair; Endodontics (nonsurgical); Periodontics (nonsurgical and surgical); Denture Repair; Dentures (1 appliance per 5 years); Bridge (1 per 7 years); Complex Extractions; Anesthesia.

coordination_of_benefits.v: Carve Out method: the plan first calculates the normal benefit it would pay, then reduces that amount by the amount paid by the primary plan.

Section headings: ENROLLMENT CONFIRMATION, BENEFIT ACCEPTANCE, MARKETING DISCLAIMER, PRODUCT INFORMATION, LIMITED PARTNER STATUS, CONSENT TO ELECTRONIC TRANSACTIONS, GHD LP.
